name: @qu/thread-ui
description: Small, composable browser-UI widgets shared by every Thread-backed message composer/reaction row (Forum today, Chat once it's ported - see each export's own doc comment): insertAtCursor() (caret-aware textarea insertion, the primitive nothing else in this repo has), renderEmojiPicker() (a quick row + '+'-expandable curated grid, reused for both reactions and composer emoji-insert), mountMentionAutocomplete() (@mention completion by alias or pub from the 2nd typed character, over @qu/services' DirectoryService/ContactsService/actor-format.js). No Custom Elements (unlike @qu/ui) - plain functions returning/mutating real DOM, matching this package's own small-composable-pieces philosophy rather than one opinionated mounted component. Browser-only.
